title: Hoodie print detail

location.series: Pentagram / Natural History Museum case study

slide_intent: Show how a mark changes at close range, because an emblem must also work as a printed arrangement of letters.
strategic_value: The enlarged N, H and M rings can make the identity feel tactile and graphic on clothing.
demonstration: A close photograph crops into a purple hoodie, showing green, pale pink and cyan letter rings beside the cord and fabric folds.
practical_value: Inspect letter edges, color contrast and the relationship between print and garment details.

content_islands.name: Enlarged letter rings
content_islands.spec: Crop into the radial letters so their individual shapes and colors are visible.

content_islands.name: Material details
content_islands.spec: Keep the drawcord, seam and folds visible across the purple fabric.

reference_purposes.Application: A close photograph crops into a purple hoodie, showing green, pale pink and cyan letter rings beside the cord and fabric folds.
